title: Matinecock Way
summary: Matinecock Way is the co-name adopted in 2015 for the intersection of Northern Boulevard and Marathon Parkway in Little Neck. The name honors continuing Matinecock presence and the Native history of northeastern Queens without treating that history as belonging only to the past.
ancestral_territory_note: Shown in relation to Matinecock Traditional Land on the current ancestral territory map.
why_this_matters: Matinecock Way places a Native community name in the everyday geography of Little Neck. Matinecock people were present at the 2015 unveiling, and the co-name recognizes that their relationship to Queens and Long Island continues.
history_content: New York City enacted the Matinecock Way co-name in 2015, and the street sign was unveiled on October 5 at Northern Boulevard and Marathon Parkway. The ceremony recognized Matinecock people as part of the living history and present-day community of Queens and Long Island.
